cards.program: Booth Asness and Liew Master in Finance
cards.schedule_note: Inaugural ~15-month MiF; BoothCamp/autumn start with summer internship then return; inaugural class graduated December 2025 (not a single autumn-only finish).
cards.internship_rate: 100% accepted internships among students seeking employment (official Class of 2025 Internship Report on Booth MiF employment-report page). 83 unique internship companies. Financial Services 74.5% of internships (IM/Research 26.5%, Diversified FS 17.6%, IB/Brokerage 13.7%, PE 5.9%, VC 5.9%, HF 1%). >75% interned outside Chicago (Northeast 27.5%, Midwest 26.5%, International 38.2%).
cards.full_time_placement: unknown (no public Class of 2025 full-time offer/accept % CSEA PDF located this run). Booth story (May 2026): within months of December graduation a significant number landed FT finance roles; individual examples include Bank of America trading strategies / mortgage securities and Canaccord Genuity/CRC-IB.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Treat internship report as primary audited signal for inaugural cohort; FT report still limited/pending relative to MBA employment report standards.
cards.notable_employers_notes: Internship employer highlights from official MiF employment-report page; FT names from official Booth MiF careers story (not a full FT census).
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Very high brand/internship signal for inaugural MiF (Evercore, MS, BofA, McKinsey, HF/PE/VC mix). FT multi-hire density still unknown without FT report.
cards.referral_network_notes: Booth Career Services + Booth alumni density; MiF recruiting calendar published for employers. Formal referral ease: unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: Elite Booth brand; inaugural cohort >100 students from around the world per careers story. Highly selective specialized MiF (non-MBA).
cards.intl_student_notes: Inaugural class described as global; International 38.2% of internship locations. Exact cohort intl %: unknown. Confirm STEM/OPT status with Booth for Fall 2027.

cards.schedule_note: IEOR MSFE Fall start (Fall 2023 cohort stats below). Distinct catalog_id from quant-bucket columbia-ieor-mfe staging label — same school/program family but this card uses locked primary+adds id columbia-msfe.
cards.internship_rate: unknown (FT placement page located; MSFE-specific internship % not on 2023–2024 FT stats page this run)
cards.full_time_placement: 97.6% placement rate for Fall 2023 start cohort (n=98 started; 83 received employment offers; 3 continuing education) — official Columbia IEOR 2023–2024 MSFE Full-Time Job Placement Stats. Average US-based salary $138,000 (range $85,000–$310,000); average bonus $29,500.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Industry mix on page: Investment Banking 74%, Asset Management 23%, Consulting & Rating 2%, Energy/Gov/Transport 1%. Class of 2025 MSFE FT PDF not located this run — use 2023–2024 official IEOR stats as latest published. Do not confuse with Columbia Business School MS Financial Economics employment report.
cards.notable_employers_notes: Companies listed under IB/AM sections of official IEOR 2023–2024 MSFE placement page.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Extremely high. Dense bulge markets/IB + elite HF/quant AM (Citadel, AQR, Balyasny, Squarepoint, Voleon) with quant trader/researcher/strats role titles; US mean base $138k.
sample_alumni_paths: Trading Desk Analyst / Program Trader / Exotic Trader
cards.referral_network_notes: Columbia IEOR career resources + NYC finance proximity. Formal referral ease: unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: Quant/FE-rigorous IEOR MSFE; ultra-competitive NYC recruiting. On primary+adds slate per gm lock — not the separate quant-bucket research wave, though content is FE/quant-heavy.
cards.intl_student_notes: Historically international-heavy FE program; exact Fall 2023 cohort intl % not stated on placement page. Confirm STEM CIP and OPT for Fall 2027.

cards.schedule_note: Official title MS in Finance & Analytics (MSFA). On-campus (evenings/weekends, F-1 + STEM eligible) or Online (not F-1). As little as ~9 months full-time or ~16 months part-time. Fall and Spring starts.
cards.internship_rate: unknown (practicum with Silicon Valley partners marketed; F-1 students need 3 consecutive full-time quarters before internship CPT per FAQ)
cards.full_time_placement: 86% of MSFA students report being employed within 6 months of graduation (following the 2021 academic year) — Leavey program page. Newer Class of 2024/2025 MSFA % not published on page this run.
cards.full_time_placement_notes: Stale official figure (2021 AY). Common roles listed: Data Analyst, Investment Strategy Analyst, Investment Operations, Senior Associate, Finance Manager, Founder & CEO, Audit and Assurance, Assistant Treasurer. 2024 practicum sponsors included Armanino, Cisco, EY, Franklin Templeton, Pluto7 (secondary coverage).
cards.notable_employers_notes: Practicum/partner examples and role list from Leavey materials; not a Class of 2025 multi-hire census.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Moderate Silicon Valley / Bay Area analytics+finance signal (Franklin Templeton, EY, Cisco practicum). Bulge multi-hire density unknown; figure is dated.
cards.referral_network_notes: Leavey Graduate Business Career Services; 25k Leavey / 100k SCU alumni; SV practicum network. Formal referral metrics unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: Avg profile on page: GPA 3.18; ~40 months work experience; 64% male / 36% female. On-campus format required for F-1.
cards.intl_student_notes: On-campus MSFA is STEM-designated and F-1 eligible; Online MSFA is NOT F-1/STEM-OPT eligible. Intl % unknown.

cards.schedule_note: Main-campus and online platforms; as few as ~9 months or 12–16 month tracks (internship-encouraged longer track). Fall admission; FINPREP summer module for some admits. Internships encouraged, not required.
cards.internship_rate: unknown (internships encouraged not required; MSF-specific internship % not published)
cards.full_time_placement: 97% of main-campus MSF students with legal right to work in the U.S. accept employment within 90 days of graduation; 74% of all main-campus MSF students (domestic + international) accept within 90 days (Eller news Nov 2024 + ROI page).
cards.full_time_placement_notes: ROI page: graduates report average salary $78,000 with high earners up to $115,000; FT ranking callout #8 US employment rates (page). Distinguish work-authorized 97% vs all-students 74% — material intl gap.
cards.notable_employers_notes: Top employers from Eller ROI page and Nov 2024 finance-vs-accounting article (not multi-hire ranked).
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Moderate–high name recognition (GS, JPM, MS, Citi) plus AZ corporate/tech (Intel, Raytheon, Honeywell, Google). Work-auth outcomes strong; all-student rate lower.
cards.referral_network_notes: Eller finance department; student-run portfolios (~$1.8M–$3M marketed); CFA Institute University Recognition. Formal referral metrics unknown.
cards.difficulty_notes: GMAT/GRE required with waivers (Finance/Accounting/STEM 3.3+ GPA or CFA L1). Competitive value narrative (resident tuition relatively low).
cards.intl_student_notes: STEM-designated. Preferred intl apply-by Dec 1; May 15 intl fall deadline on program page. All-student 74% @90 days vs 97% work-authorized — plan for domestic skew in US placement odds.
